task.description:
Design tests for EE-01 (Start instance). Read the test guide and existing integration tests for patterns.

1. Write `tests/specs/EE-01.md` with test cases covering all acceptance criteria
2. Write `tests/integration/ee01_start_instance_test.zig` with integration tests

Test cases must cover:
- TC-EE-01-01: Successfully start instance with initial_variables → 201, instance_id, status=ACTIVE
- TC-EE-01-02: Start with correlation_key → 201, correlation_key stored
- TC-EE-01-03: Start with non-existent definition_id → 404
- TC-EE-01-04: Start with DRAFT definition → 409 definition_not_active
- TC-EE-01-05: Start with DEPRECATED definition → 409 definition_not_active
- TC-EE-01-06: Duplicate correlation_key for same definition → 409 duplicate_correlation_key
- TC-EE-01-07: Same correlation_key for different definition → 201 (not a conflict)
- TC-EE-01-08: null initial_variables → 422 invalid_input
- TC-EE-01-09: initial_variables is array, not object → 422 invalid_input
- TC-EE-01-10: initial_variables is empty object {} → 201 (valid)
- TC-EE-01-11: No correlation_key → 201, multiple instances allowed for same definition
- TC-EE-01-12: Verify definition snapshot is stored in instance_definition_snapshots

Follow the patterns from tests/integration/pd04_lifecycle_test.zig exactly.
Note: BPM_TEST_DB_URL may not be set in CI — if not set, skip integration tests (same pattern as other integration tests).

Run `zig build test` to verify compilation exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-01.md exists with all test case definitions

result.summary: Designed and wrote 12 integration tests for EE-01 (Start Instance). Created tests/specs/EE-01.md documenting all test cases with acceptance criteria coverage matrix. Created tests/integration/ee01_start_instance_test.zig following exact pd04_lifecycle_test.zig patterns, covering happy paths (TC-EE-01-01/02/10/11), error paths (TC-EE-01-03/04/05/06/08/09), cross-definition behaviour (TC-EE-01-07), and snapshot verification (TC-EE-01-12). Added engine export to src/bpm.zig and registered test in tests/integration/main_test.zig. zig build test exits 0.
